gloss: to start crying; to burst into tears

definitions.gloss: to start crying; to burst into tears; to begin to cry
definitions.explanation: To suddenly begin to cry, often with emotion.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}が{急|きゅう}に{泣|な}き{出|だ}した。
{映画|えいが}の{最後|さいご}で{泣|な}き{出|だ}してしまった。
examples.english: I burst into tears at the end of the movie.

examples.japanese: {悲|かな}しい{知|し}らせを{聞|き}いて{泣|な}き{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I started crying when I heard the sad news.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Compound verb: {泣|な}く + {出|だ}す.

NUANCE: The {出|だ}す component emphasizes the sudden onset of crying. It suggests that the crying begins abruptly, often triggered by something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{急|きゅう}に{泣|な}き{出|だ}す: to suddenly start crying
・わあっと{泣|な}き{出|だ}す: to burst out crying loudly

RELATED:
・{笑|わら}い{出|だ}す: to start laughing
・{怒|おこ}り{出|だ}す: to start getting angry
